evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD is dominated by data governance, testing, documentation, and pipeline reliability language (data quality, tests, lineage, scalability) with no velocity/speed phrases present anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: Énergie (smart grids, transition énergétique, utilities) et Retail (omnicanalité, supply chain, e-commerce)
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: This is a consulting role (ALTEN) serving energy and retail sector clients on data platform projects — no financial reporting, regulatory, or safety-critical language is present, placing it as moderate rather than high or low.
evidence.collaboration_width: Data Analysts; Data Engineers; Data Scientists

evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role involves building out lakehouse architecture and modelling layers with named tools/frameworks (Databricks, dbt, Kimball/Data Vault) for client engagements, indicating a growing/mid-maturity data practice rather than greenfield-from-zero or a fully mature internal team.

evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role splits evenly between serving the internal data function (colleagues: analysts, engineers, scientists) and translating client business problems (retail/energy), with no single orientation dominating.
evidence.autonomy_level: Mettre en œuvre et diffuser les meilleures pratiques de modélisation de données... Participer à la veille technologique
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role both defines/diffuses modelling best practices and mentors juniors (strategic) while also translating specific client business problems into delivered data models (execution), giving a mixed signal.

evidence.testing_framing: Être le garant de la qualité de la donnée, de la mise en place de tests automatisés (via dbt, Great Expectations)
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and data quality appear as an owned responsibility ("être le garant" = being the guarantor) with named tools (dbt, Great Expectations), not just a skill listed in requirements.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Garantir la performance des requêtes, la scalabilité des pipelines et l'optimisation des coûts de calcul
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Operational reliability (pipeline scalability, query performance, data quality/testing) is a recurring secondary concern behind the primary delivery/modelling framing, without regulatory or compliance risk language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Concevoir, développer et optimiser les architectures de données de type Lakehouse (Databricks)
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role mixes building new lakehouse architecture ("concevoir, développer") with optimizing/scaling existing pipelines ("optimiser", "garantir la performance"), giving a mixed greenfield/fix-scale signal.
evidence.loss_aversion: "Garantir la performance des requêtes, la scalabilité des pipelines et l'optimisation des coûts de calcul" reflects concern for pipeline reliability/cost, not compliance or stakeholder trust — moderate framing.
